notes: Initial release: search + tag filter, Settings page (theming controls), and the Claude dev panel.

Settings moved from a separate page into a non-blocking left-side panel (live-tunable alongside the Claude panel, which moved to the right and also no longer dims the page). Added a left category sidebar for browsing prompts.
